text: In Lean 4, 'simp only [h₁, h₂]' differs from 'simp [h₁, h₂]' in that:
choices: simp only uses h₁ and h₂ but NOT the default simp set (@[simp] lemmas)
simp only applies lemmas left-to-right only
explanation: 'simp only [h₁, h₂]' uses exactly h₁ and h₂ (disabling the default simp set). 'simp [h₁, h₂]' adds to the default set. Using 'simp only' makes proofs more robust and explicit.
